rationale: 95/243 describes a rider and has no mtarpəl. In the same episode, 95/245 has 'mtarpəl u səsyo' ('the horse stumbled'). The quoted donkey passage itself is at PrS 50/11–12, already compatible with a separate Prym–Socin page/line reference. Thus 95/245 is a plausible correction of the supplementary attestation, but it is not the source of the quoted donkey example; do not automatically replace 95/243 with the checker's PrS match.
